transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
I'm here because I've been feeling constantly depressed, sad, and down for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for over two years, and I just can't seem to shake this low mood.
Can you tell me more about your low mood over the past two years, has it been consistently severe or have you had periods where your symptoms were milder?

It has been a continuous, heavy drag for about two years and one month now, with absolutely no breaks or periods of relief. I don't really get "better" days; it is just a constant, empty low that leaves me feeling completely pessimistic about things ever changing.
Do you find that you've lost interest in activities or hobbies that you once enjoyed, or are you still able to find some pleasure in the things you do?

I'm not really sure if I've lost interest, as I haven't really thought about hobbies much lately. Mostly, I just feel so empty and emotionally numb that I don't really feel much of anything at all. It's hard to say if I find pleasure in things when everything just feels so flat.
Can you describe a typical day for you, and how your symptoms affect your daily functioning and ability to take care of yourself?

I'm not really sure how to describe a typical day or my daily functioning. Every day just blends together, and I'm constantly feeling sad, empty, and helpless from the moment I wake up. It is hard to explain it beyond just dragging myself through that same heavy feeling every day.

Have you experienced any distinct periods of at least two weeks where your depressive symptoms were significantly more severe, or has the intensity of your symptoms remained relatively consistent over the past two years?

No, I haven't really had any distinct two-week periods where it suddenly got much worse. It has just been a very consistent, constant level of sadness and emptiness for the past two years and one month. It feels like a low-grade, heavy weight that just stays exactly the same every single day.
How have your symptoms impacted your relationships with family and friends, and have you noticed any changes in your social interactions over the past two years?
I'm not really sure how it has impacted my relationships. I've just been keeping to myself a lot lately because of my low mood, so I haven't been interacting with people much.
Have you experienced any major life events, significant stressors, or changes in your life circumstances over the past two years that you think might be contributing to your low mood?

I can't think of any specific major life events, stressors, or sudden changes that triggered this. The low mood has just been a persistent, gradual feeling over the last two years. It just seemed to develop slowly without any clear cause.
You've mentioned that your symptoms have been constant for over two years, can you think of any times when you felt even slightly better, or has it been a completely unchanging experience for you?

It has been a completely unchanging experience for the entire two years and one month. I haven't had any periods where I felt even slightly better or lighter. It has just been a constant, steady state of depression and emptiness every single day.
Is there anything else you'd like to share or discuss about your symptoms or experiences over the past two years that might help me better understand your condition?

I just feel completely hopeless about the future and truly believe that my situation will never get better. I've resigned myself to this empty feeling, and I often find myself crying because I feel so helpless to change any of it.

Have you ever experienced any unusual thoughts, such as hearing voices or believing things that others might not believe, or seen things that aren't really there, especially when you're feeling your most depressed or hopeless?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I have never heard voices, seen things that aren't there, or had any unusual beliefs, even when I am feeling at my absolute lowest.
